title: (0Day) Super Magic PHPSandbox Command Injection Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass the sandbox on affected installations of Super Magic. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the PHPSandbox endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute PHP code. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escape the sandbox and execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account.
